主要内容: Optical Cable Corporation (the “Company” or “OCC®”) issued a press release announcing that the Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.02 per share on the Company’s common stock effective January 15, 2014. The Company’s Board of Directors declared that the dividend would be paid on or about February 14, 2014 to shareholders of record on January 28, 2014. A copy of the press release announcing the dividend is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this Form 8-K.
